title: QueryBuilder broken on web - Invalid regular expression: invalid group specifier name

## Issue Description
The QueryBuilder is broken in the new 0.2.29 release due to this change: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/4760
Regex lookbehinds are not supported in on a lot of web environments, a fallback should be implemented.
This affects any driver that uses JavascriptCore (Safari, React Native, ...)

### Expected Behavior

<!--
  A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
-->
I'd expect QueryBuilder to work

<!--
